objective: Test whether the CertaIndex probe prompt delays first answer consensus and improves the accuracy-output-token trade-off relative to Simple@32.

scope.report_split_policy: pool all available problem-seed trajectories; do not report or select by split
scope.diagnostic_grouping: retain model, benchmark, and seed for pairing and equal-environment macro aggregation

certaindex32.difference_from_original_certaindex_mid: matched cap 32 instead of the original cap 20

shared_collection.online_optimization: stop collecting a problem after the first eligible three-probe consensus

requirements: all probes certain under the same uncertainty-word predicate
shared_stop_rule.delivery: latest answer in the first eligible consensus window
shared_stop_rule.no_stop: deliver the frozen full answer if naturally completed; otherwise empty/incorrect

primary_metrics: delivered accuracy and accuracy delta versus frozen full generation
Harm: full correct and stopped delivery wrong
Rescue: full wrong and stopped delivery correct
all-generated output-token saving including consumed probe outputs
CertaIndex delay/advance/tie/no-stop transitions relative to Simple
Simple harms protected and new harms introduced by CertaIndex

aggregation.robustness: equal-weight macro over model x benchmark x seed environments

cost_boundary.included: main output tokens through stop plus consumed probe output tokens
cost_boundary.reported_separately: probe prompt/prefill tokens and auxiliary wall time
cost_boundary.excluded_from_primary: prompt/prefill tokens, wall-clock latency, KV-cache memory
